note: Opened and set aside: Wei et al. 2019 (J Chem Ecol 45(2): 136-145, 10.1007/s10886-018-1020-7) and Wei et al. 2021 (Plant Sci, 10.1016/j.plantsci.2020.110784) apply methyl jasmonate to Jacobaea vulgaris and J. aquatica, which are not Senecio (Senecio jacobaea is a synonym of Jacobaea vulgaris), and the 2019 plants were axenic tissue cultures. Van Dam et al. 1993 (Oecologia 95: 425-430) cut leaves of 'Senecio jacobaea' with scissors, which is wounding and the same Jacobaea. Victorio et al. 2010 (Rev Ceres 57(5), 10.1590/s0034-737x2010000500002) is in vitro germination of S. cineraria on culture medium with GA3, tissue culture and a species outside the queue. Tursun et al. 2015 (KSU J Nat Sci 18(4): 48-54) tests temperature, scarification, pH, light duration and salt on S. vulgaris, with no GA3, KNO3 or hormone; it is on the wanted list for sense_light_nonvisual. Vidotto et al. 2013 and Hall et al. 2023 are ragweed allelopathy papers with no Senecio. The germination hits on S. vulgaris were light and photoperiod studies, which belong to sense_light_nonvisual and are held by wanted lines on main (harvest-c12:85 to 87). The Asteraceae review search returned doc.rero.ch 309979 (Lariguet and Dunand), with no Senecio measurement.
